judgment_refs.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
judgment_refs.note: Blueprint identity alone does not prove authorization or regulatory agency status.

judgment_refs.phrase: moving or preparing to move in any direction
judgment_refs.note: Original motion or a hand signal visible to the approaching driver is required; 0.05 m/s is only a sensor convention.

judgment_refs.phrase: making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480
judgment_refs.note: Original equipment qualification and full-frame pixel review are distinct sources.

judgment_refs.phrase: If possible, drive in a lane that is not adjacent
judgment_refs.note: Lane topology, traffic, roadway, weather and other conditions inform possibility and safety; no numeric legal cutoff is supplied.

judgment_refs.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_refs.note: Officer identity, direction content, recipient, visibility and time require original review.

sweep_specs.rationale: Source qualification, visibility, possibility, safety and officer direction remain original-review judgments; selected categorical probes do not create legal cutoffs.
missing_inputs: Original agency authorization, lamp equipment and pixels, approach, lane/traffic/weather safety and officer-direction review.
